author: cellish
body:
Hello!
My IGN is: xTekz 
I want to be unbanned on this server because i really really like the server and its one of the best servers i've every played on!
I hope i can get unbanned because i want to play with 2 of my friends who are playing there and it was like 1 - 1.5 years ago since i got banned...
I got banned for fly hacks, and thats true. I was flying but i didn't use killaura or anything else, i was just flying around.
You know its periods when u are playing on servers very much and when u are playing on other servers very much!
I wasn't playing on that server very much so i wanted to see how it was to be a hacker... At the begining i thought it was very funny but when i got banned i felt pretty bad...
And for just maybe 1 month ago i played on the server when i was with my friend on his computer! It was awesome!
If i can get unbanned i would be the happiest person ever! <3
PS... i promise to never hack or fly or anything on the server again ty :)
